text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B after gains felt satisfying, but I should decide whether to sell based on my overall plan, not just the pleasure of locking in a profit.","My account fell substantially by Period 5 despite earlier gains; I should keep risk and diversification in mind rather than focus only on winning positions.","I rarely trade, and doing nothing can be reasonable—but I should still review my holdings periodically and act when they no longer fit my goals."]}
